name: Camofox-Browser
description: Private Camofox Browser REST backend for local AI agents and MCP adapters. It provides token-efficient Firefox-based browser automation and optional password-protected noVNC access for shared human-and-LLM browsing. This template pins the official multi-architecture 1.14.0 image, persists profiles locally, requires bearer authentication, and disables upstream crash telemetry.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent browser profiles, cookies, uploads, and short-lived traces. This directory can contain login credentials and must be backed up and protected.

ports.name: REST API Port
ports.description: Authenticated Camofox REST API. Restrict access to LAN or VPN.

ports.name: noVNC Web Port
ports.description: Optional noVNC browser desktop. Keep restricted to LAN/VPN; noVNC traffic is not encrypted by default.

variables.name: Enable noVNC
variables.description: Set to 1 to enable shared human-and-LLM browser access through the noVNC web interface.

variables.name: noVNC Password
variables.description: Password for interactive noVNC access. Set 8 random ASCII characters before enabling noVNC; classic VNC authentication ignores additional characters.

variables.name: noVNC Resolution
variables.description: Virtual display resolution used by the interactive browser desktop.

variables.name: noVNC Bind Address
variables.description: Required inside Docker so the mapped noVNC port is reachable. Keep the host port restricted to LAN/VPN.

variables.name: View Only
variables.description: Set to 1 to prevent human mouse and keyboard input; keep 0 for interactive login and shared browsing.

variables.name: Access Key
variables.description: Required bearer token protecting normal REST and MCP operations.

variables.name: Cookie API Key
variables.description: Required bearer token for cookie import. Use a separate long random value.

variables.name: Bind Address
variables.description: Required inside the container so the mapped REST port is reachable.

variables.name: Service Port
variables.description: Internal HTTP port; keep aligned with the container port mapping.

variables.name: Cookie Directory
variables.description: Sandboxed location for optional Netscape-format cookie imports.

variables.name: Upload Directory
variables.description: Sandboxed location from which agents may upload files to websites.

variables.name: Trace Directory
variables.description: Short-lived Playwright trace archives when tracing is explicitly enabled.

variables.name: Disable Crash Telemetry
variables.description: Keep crash and hang reports local for this private deployment.

variables.name: Maximum Sessions
variables.description: Limit simultaneous isolated browser sessions for a small private deployment.

variables.name: Maximum Tabs per Session
variables.description: Limit tabs in each browser session.

variables.name: Maximum Global Tabs
variables.description: Hard global tab limit for the service.

variables.name: Browser Idle Shutdown
variables.description: Stop the browser engine after five idle minutes while keeping the REST service available.
